entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I'm calling because... well, I'm just so disappointed. I need to make a return.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's 884-2915-B. It's for a helmet. The thing is, it was a gift, and it just didn't work out. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed this money back.

I understand. Thank you for that order number. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the helmet here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's the color. My nephew said he wanted a blue one, but I guess he meant a different shade of blue. It's a shame, it's a really nice helmet and safety is so important, but he won't wear it. The box is still unopened, just sitting in my closet.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. It looks like the order was delivered about 52 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.
Oh, has it really been that long? With the holidays, time just got away from me. I really hope that's not a problem. I feel awful about this.

It's no problem at all. Our policy for standard items like this allows for a return within 90 days. Since the box is unopened and it's well within that timeframe, I can process this return for you right now.
Oh, you can? That is such a relief! Thank you so much, Diana. You've really taken a weight off my shoulders today.

I'm happy I could help. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. You'll receive a full refund once it arrives back at our warehouse.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out today. Thank you again for being so understanding.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thank you!
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
